drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_gmc.c.fact: VRAM MC to GPU-view physical uses subtract MC base then add vram_base_offset. The inverse in our model is original algebra, not a claimed Linux pa2mc function.

facts: get_vm_pde converts only non-leaf PDE without SYSTEM, then checks 48-bit/64-byte bounds.
get_vm_pte changes flags, not addresses; a generic PTE/PDE conversion rule is not justified.
vram_base_offset comes from mc_fb_offset plus XGMI node offset.
On x86_64 APU without passthrough, aper_base is mc_fb_offset rather than PCI BAR0 start.
48-bit MC and page-address masks are numeric limits, not Windows mapping or ownership proof.
